title: Hello Kitty VPN Routing Rules Package Manifest v1 Contract
description: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for RoutingRulesManifest v1 and routing package data files.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version counter for anti-rollback protection.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the routing rules package was generated and signed.

expiresAt.description: UTC timestamp after which this routing package is considered stale and requires refresh.

minimumClientVersion.description: Minimum client build version required to parse and apply this package format.

keyId.description: Identifier of the trusted routing signing key in the client root trust store.

caps.description: Package limits and safety caps enforced during download and decompression.

files.description: List of validated payload files included in the routing package bundle.

signature.description: Base64url unpadded strict DER ECDSA P-256/SHA-256 signature over exact canonical manifest bytes.

PackageCaps.description: Safety limits protecting client from zip bombs, memory exhaustion, and route table overflow.

maxDecodedPackageBytes.description: Maximum allowed total uncompressed size in bytes (hard ceiling 8 MiB).

maxFiles.description: Maximum allowed number of payload files (hard ceiling 8).

maxCidrEntries.description: Maximum allowed aggregate CIDR entries across all CIDR files (hard ceiling 65,536).

maxDomainEntries.description: Maximum allowed aggregate domain entries across all domain files (hard ceiling 10,000).

maxDnsCacheEntries.description: Maximum allowed client DNS cache entries for split routing.

maxDnsCacheBytes.description: Maximum allowed memory in bytes for client DNS cache.

ManifestFileEntry.description: Metadata for a single payload file in the routing bundle.

name.description: File name in the archive bundle (no directory traversals allowed).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 hash of the uncompressed file bytes.

size.description: Exact size of uncompressed file in bytes.

type.description: Payload file type determining parser and validation rules.

entryCount.description: Number of validated entries (CIDR count or domain count).

RoutingPackageConfig.description: Routing rules configuration structure stored in config-type payload files.
